preprocessing.name: canonical256_jpegpair_familydro_letterbox299
preprocessing.source_decode: Pillow decode followed by RGB conversion
preprocessing.shared_train_augmentation: one random horizontal flip p=0.5 shared by both views

objective.group_definition: fake forgery family from the frozen manifest; Real remains a separately weighted binary class risk
objective.robust_objective: 0.5 * Real risk + 0.5 * Group-DRO-weighted worst-family fake risk
objective.classification: cross-entropy on one uniformly sampled anchor JPEG view
objective.second_view_role: consistency regularization only, without an additional supervised cross-entropy term
objective.consistency: per-image Jensen-Shannon divergence between the two class-probability distributions

optimization.batch_group_composition: 4 real plus one from each fake family plus one rotating extra fake-family sample
optimization.epoch_sampling: all 39600 training images exactly once with the original 50:50 real/fake marginal and equal fake-family counts

model_selection.reason: Preserve checkpoint-selection comparability with the M7 Mixed-JPEG and JPEG-consistency seed-42 pilots.
